entries.660ad679e04520bf: The long-term vision is "a company that conveys the joy of making things," and the medium-term management plan "Move! 2027," covering the fiscal years from the year ended March 2026 to the year ending March 2028, takes "sustainable growth for the next 100 years" as its basic policy. In the Household Equipment Business, the company aims to establish and strengthen its brand identity and expand market share through product launches; in the Industrial Equipment Business, it aims to focus on key markets and strengthen sales of high value-added products; and in the IT-Related Business, it aims to strengthen collaboration with other businesses and maintain the profitability of existing businesses. The medium-term management plan also sets performance targets for its final fiscal year, but the numerical figures are not stated here due to the rules governing this text.
entries.74f32fddd5d4da75: Household equipment is developed and manufactured by the company and its production subsidiaries in Taiwan and Thailand, and sold by sales subsidiaries in North America, Europe, Australia and other regions, so the company has overseas bases for both production and sales. The Industrial Equipment Business is positioned as an application of the technology cultivated in sewing machines, and is described as the second pillar after household equipment.

entries.7b88c40049158312: In the household equipment business it provides household sewing machines and embroidery machines; in the industrial equipment business, desktop robots, servo presses and die-cast products; and in the IT-related business, IT software and information processing services. As other, it also engages in real estate leasing.
entries.87e482697fd4f745: The fiscal year ended March 2026, the first year of the medium-term management plan, saw revenue exceed the previous fiscal year. In the Household Equipment Business, sales of mid- to high-end models were firm in North America, while in Asian markets there was a decline following the strong previous year. In the Industrial Equipment Business, orders were firm against a backdrop of capital investment demand in Asian markets, centered on China, and orders also increased at the sales subsidiary that began operations in India.
